discovery.result: Samsung Philippines identifies Gray Wi-Fi SKU SM-X620NZAAXTC as 8 GB RAM / 128 GB storage and publishes its hardware details.

discovery.source_kind: Exact local 5G SKU and configuration specifications
discovery.result: Samsung Philippines identifies Gray 5G SKU SM-X626BZAAXTC as 8 GB RAM / 128 GB storage and publishes its hardware, cellular-band and SIM/eSIM details.

discovery.source_kind: Global launch date and model-family specifications
discovery.result: Samsung announced the S10 FE family on 2025-04-02 and states availability in select markets beginning 2025-04-03. The story identifies FE+ display, cameras, chipset, memory options, battery, charging and launch OS; it is not Philippine-sale evidence.

discovery.source_kind: Philippine launch announcement and local configuration availability
discovery.result: Samsung Philippines announced local availability from 2025-05-15 for the Galaxy Tab S10 FE+ 5G (128 GB), in Gray and Blue. The announcement does not state the Wi-Fi FE+ first-sale date or RAM for the 5G launch option.
Samsung's local story describes the FE+ 5G as available from PHP 39,990; RAM is not stated, so this is retained as model/network-level evidence only.
Samsung's expired July 2025 offer table lists FE+ 5G (8 GB + 128 GB) at SRP PHP 39,990, with trade-in savings available separately; campaign dates were July 1–September 30, 2025.

discovery.source_kind: Current local SRP for exact 8 GB / 128 GB Wi-Fi and 5G variants
discovery.result: The live Samsung Philippines trade-in page, valid through 2026-11-30, lists SRP PHP 47,490 for Galaxy Tab S10 FE+ Wi-Fi (8 GB + 128 GB) and PHP 52,690 for 5G (8 GB + 128 GB). SRP excludes optional trade-in value; checkout stock was not checked.

discovery.source_kind: Exynos 1580 process, CPU and GPU specifications
discovery.result: Samsung lists third-generation 4 nm EUV FinFET and Xclipse 540 graphics. Its Exynos 1580 CPU specification lists Cortex-A720 at 2.9 and 2.6 GHz and Cortex-A520 at 1.95 GHz.
Samsung Philippines lists the security-update period as valid until 30 April 2032 on the exact local FE+ product pages; this is a support-period endpoint, not an OS-upgrade-count guarantee.

discovery.source_kind: Secondary technical cross-check for the Galaxy Tab S10 FE+
discovery.result: NanoReview's FE+ page exposes 8/128 and 12/256 options and lists LPDDR5X, UFS 3.1, 4 speakers, Dolby Atmos, no wireless charging and Li-Ion chemistry. It reports 90 Hz and 800 nits maximum; the brightness measurement condition is unclear.

discovery.source_kind: Secondary global model cross-check; conflicting claims are not promoted
discovery.result: Kimovil lists global 8/128 Wi-Fi and 5G versions and LPDDR5X, but this page also reports 120 Hz and 1750 nits, contrary to Samsung's 90 Hz / 600 nits max and 800 nits HBM. Its conflicting panel data are not used as local product specifications; its Li-Polymer claim is retained only as unresolved chemistry evidence.
Samsung's 2025 Q3 interim report labels Galaxy Tab S10 FE / FE+ (April 2025) and lists Exynos 1580, Android 15 and One UI 7.0.
